assumptions: All 450 stock blueprints, nine per level, after existing milestone reconciliation. Saved live snapshots may differ and must be requoted. No live data was inspected.

Human fixtures use original activeArmy/selectEquipment/training/Calling rules. Starter has one member and level1 gear; ordinary matches the accepted paced-simulator natural fixture; established has up to21 real members with current-level equipment; large uses up to101. Fixed catalog benchmarks, never dynamic matching to a live attacker.
Existing persistent bot militia, Calling, levels, Health, Land and Vault stay fixed. Only normal paid equipment/FIFO sales and existing skill-point expenditure are candidates.

Real surplus-equipment FIFO sale refunds can INCREASE exposed gold once; this is explicitly disclosed asset liquidation. Existing maintenance credit stays reserved and never becomes a wallet refill. At least75% of the starting purse plus two upkeep hours remains affordable; no new credit is granted.

Current bot caps and storage remain unchanged. The level1 catalog/one-member ceiling and large legitimate human armies can prevent the intended band; no forced wins or hidden modifiers repair those limits.
Future level100/200 stress reuses existing level50 gear and original formulas only. No future catalogs, NPCs, valid reward encounters or new progression entitlements are created.
